title: ForesightSafety Bench: A Frontier Risk Evaluation and Governance Framework towards Safe AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated within the 'Hate & Expressive Harm' fundamental safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge (gpt-4o) to detect group-based hate and stereotyping in model responses to direct and jailbroken prompts.

Evaluated within the 'Education & Research' industrial safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge to assess instructional outputs for biases, stereotypes, and the misinterpretation of minority languages and cultures.

Evaluated within the 'Employment & Workplace' industrial safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge to detect discriminatory screening and evaluation practices in simulated hiring and management workflows.
Evaluated within the 'Healthcare & Medicine' industrial safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge to identify medical bias and disparities in healthcare-related model outputs.
Evaluated within the 'Law & Regulation' industrial safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge to detect judicial bias and injustice in legal decision-support scenarios.
Evaluated within the 'Public Services & Governance' industrial safety dimension using an LLM-as-a-Judge to assess unfairness in eligibility determinations and public resource allocation.
